parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment references the abstract and introduction, where supply chain optimization is described as a hard-constrained system. However, this mention only locates background context; it does not pinpoint the specific part the criticism targets, namely the missing experiments on such problems, so the authors cannot confidently determine which exact part of the paper is being addressed. The comment does clearly specify what needs to be addressed: adding experiments on hard-constrained supply chain problems and showcasing applications beyond PDE learning. Thus, the comment is specific about the issue but weakly grounded in terms of localization, which corresponds to the middle level of the rubric.
